Super Sword.Effect: +1 dmg every hit, and every 3 seconds the sword attracts the opponent.

Axe.Effect: +1% crit-chance and +2 crit damage each hit

Super Axe.Effect: +1% crit-chance and +2 crit damage each hit. Does double both if hit above the opponent. A shield is on the complete otherside of the axe.

Shovel.Effect: -1/12 opponent max size each hit. Minimum 1/12.

Super Shovel.Effect: -1/12 opponent max size each hit. Minimum 1/12. 1/12 of the opponent's max HP is lost and a cube containing that same exact lost HP amount. If either ball touches it, they gain their HP back.

Dagger.Effect: Moves the dagger towards the opponent. +0.1 dagger speed each hit.

Clone.Effect: Duplicates perfectly, including current HP. If the OG dies, the rest do.

Super Clone.Effect: Duplicates perfectly, including current HP. When the OG dies, all clones get sent to 1 HP. When they die, they explode for 5dmg. As long as even one clone exists, it lives.

Bow.Effect: Shoots an arrow. +1 reload speed every arrow hit.

Super Baby.Effect: Starts crying, pushing away opponents. Heals +1 HP every 2 seconds.

RPG.Effect: Shoots a rocket that explodes upon contact with the wall or opponent. +1 explosion size each shot.

Super RPG.Effect: Shoots a rocket that explodes upon contact with the wall or opponent and a grenade that deals 3dmg and has the same explosion size as the rocket. +1 explosion size each shot.

Lasso.Effect: If it hits the opponent, it pulls the opponent with the rope towards the person.

Ruler.Effect: Teleports towards opponents. +1 TP reload-speed each hit.

Grapple.Effect: Launches itself towards where the grapple shoots and hits. Deals extra damage to the opponent while grappling.

Super Grapple.Effect: Launches itself towards where the grapple shoots and hits. Deals extra damage to the opponent while grappling. When it hits anything it explodes, and also throws an arrow while it's flying.

Parry.Effect: Glows and then reflects anything that hits it (damage-wise). Parry-length increases by +1 each parry.

Super Parry.Effect: Glows and then reflects anything that hits it (damage-wise), along with a stun and disarm for the same exact time. Parry-length increases by +1 each parry.

Yoink.Effect: Steals the ability/weapon of the opponent when it is hit. It returns to normal after a while. +1 yoink-length each yoink.

Super Yoink.Effect: Steals the super version of ability/weapon (if it has one) of the opponent when it is hit. It returns to normal after a while. +1 yoink-length each yoink. When it yoinks again, it keeps all prior yoinks and reveals them all at once.

Glass.Effect: Whenever hit, it explodes leaving shards that deal 1 dmg on the field.

Mother.Effect: Spawns 2 children that have 30 HP and are the same size as the Babys.

Super Mother.Effect: Spawns 2 children that have 30 HP and are the same size as the Babys. Every single time it touches a child, they both heal 1 HP.

Vampire.Effect: Heals +1 HP each time it hits.

Consume.Effect: +1 size each hit. Every 5 it gains +3 hp.

Needle.Effect: First hit causes 1 DMG every 10 seconds. Each later hit lowers that timer by 0.5 seconds.

Portal.Effect: Shoots 2 portals (orange and blue) that teleport players between both. Teleporting deals 1dmg to opponent. +1 Portal reload-speed each shot.

Speed.Effect: +1 speed each hit. Speeds up for a second leaving fire tracks that deal +1 hp when the opponent touches it after a certain amount of distance is traveled.

Super Speed.Effect: +1 speed each hit. Speeds up for a second leaving fire tracks that deal +1 hp when the opponent touches it after a certain amount of distance is traveled. It sometimes uses the Phase Ability, and when the dash is finishes, a lightning like Thor's is shot out.

Mace.Effect: Stuns whenever it hits. +1 stun-time each hit.

Super Mace.Effect: Stuns whenever it hits, with a yoink effect after. +1 stun-time each hit.

Stonks.Effect: A graph on the left shows stocks. DMG-Stocks and Speed: {0-10}, and Shield:{0,1}

Time.Effect: Every 3sec, it rewinds itself for 2 sec, undamaging and reversing all it's movement.

Omega.Effect: Same abilities as Bow, RPG, Clone, Glass, Parry, Portal. +1 DMG, Speed, Heal, Omega-Tracker Speed, Shield, Ball-Size, Stun-Time, Portal-reload speed, and +1% crit-chance, x2 crit-dmg, -4% opponent-size each hit.

Mjolnir.Effect: Throws the hammer. If it hits the wall, it shoots out lightning that is aimed at the opponent. +1 stun-time and stuns the opponent if either hits.

Phase.Effect: Turns slightly transparent and ignores any interactions. Phase-length increases by +1 each parry.

Staff.Effect: Heals +1 HP each time it hits.

Reaper.Effect: The first hit starts a 90 second death clock. Every opponent hit removes 1 second as well.
